text:
𝗕𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗗𝗠𝗔𝗡 𝟲/𝟮𝟰! 🔥🇦🇺

Australia beat England by 7 wickets in Perth, chasing in 23.3 overs.
Mahli Beardman took 6/24 on ODI debut, the best by an Australian on debut. Lead 1-0.

Best debut ever? 👇

#AUSvENG #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗕𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗗𝗠𝗔𝗡 𝗞𝗔 𝗞𝗔𝗠𝗔𝗟, 𝟲/𝟮𝟰! 🔥🇦🇺

👉 Perth ke pehle ODI mein Australia ne England ko 7 wickets se haraya
👉 Mahli Beardman ne debut par 6/24 liye, Australian ke liye debut par sabse acchi bowling
👉 Chase sirf 23.3 overs mein khatam, series mein 1-0 ki lead

Is se behtar ODI debut dekha hai kabhi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #AUSvENG #Cricket
